title: Analysis-Meta's AI splurge lays bare its compute conundrum
title_zh: Analysis-Meta 的 AI 挥霍暴露了其计算难题
summary: Meta can simultaneously fuel its own AI ambitions and rent out its scarce computing capacity to bolster returns, CEO Mark Zuckerberg signaled on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 首席执行官马克扎克伯格周三表示，Meta 可以同时推动自己的人工智能雄心，并出租其稀缺的计算能力以提高回报。

title: Amazon, Walmart AI detect 'made in USA' fraud but do not flag it, study says
title_zh: 研究称，亚马逊、沃尔玛人工智能检测到“美国制造”欺诈，但没有标记它
summary: By Jody Godoy July 30 (Reuters) - Amazon and Walmart AI shopping assistants can often detect when "Made in USA" product labels are false, but the big retailers are not using that technology to crack
summary_zh: 作者：乔迪·戈多伊 7 月 30 日（路透社）——亚马逊和沃尔玛的人工智能购物助手通常可以检测出“美国制造”产品标签的虚假信息，但大型零售商并没有使用该技术来破解

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rebound ahead of inflation data
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标普 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在通胀数据公布前反弹
summary: Traders will be watching Apple and Amazon earnings, fresh inflation data, and the direction of Treasurys and oil prices.
summary_zh: 交易员将关注苹果和亚马逊的收益、最新的通胀数据以及美国国债和油价的走向。

title: Big Tech earnings meet IPO buzz: What to watch Thursday
title_zh: 大型科技公司盈利遭遇 IPO 热潮：周四看点
summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews the biggest market catalysts for Thursday, July 30, including highly anticipated earnings from Apple (AAPL) and Amazon (AMZN) as well as the expected IPO debuts of Jersey Mike's and Reformation.
summary_zh: 寻求趋势主持人乔希·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 预览了 7 月 30 日星期四最大的市场催化剂，包括苹果 (AAPL) 和亚马逊 (AMZN) 备受期待的盈利，以及 Jersey Mike's 和 Reformation 预计首次公开募股 (IPO)。

title: Microsoft's Q4 results are 'narrative changing,' according to one analyst
title_zh: 一位分析师表示，微软第四季度的业绩正在“改变叙事”
summary: D.A. Davidson head of technology research Gil Luria reacts to Microsoft's fiscal fourth quarter earnings and revenue results, going on to explain two bear cases for the Big Tech stock.
summary_zh: DA戴维森技术研究主管吉尔·卢里亚（Gil Luria）对微软第四财季的盈利和收入结果做出了反应，并解释了这家大型科技股的两个悲观案例。

title: Microsoft shares rise after Q4 beat
title_zh: 第四季度业绩好转后微软股价上涨
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) rise after reporting Q4 results. Market Domination Host Josh Lipton delivers the latest earnings details as the numbers cross the wire.
summary_zh: 微软（MSFT）公布第四季度业绩后股价上涨。 《市场支配》主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 随着数字的变化提供了最新的盈利细节。

title: Meta stock falls on Q2 earnings miss: What's next for capex?
title_zh: Meta 股票因第二季度盈利未达预期而下跌：资本支出的下一步是什么？
summary: Meta (META) reported second quarter results on Wednesday after the closing bell. Earnings per share (EPS) came in at $6.18 (compared to analyst estimates of $7.14), and revenue came in at $60.80 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $60.24 billion).
summary_zh: Meta (META) 于周三收盘后公布了第二季度业绩。每股收益 (EPS) 为 6.18 美元（分析师预期为 7.14 美元），收入为 608 亿美元（分析师预期为 602.4 亿美元）。

title: Apple options trades: What's a covered call and how does it work?
title_zh: 苹果期权交易：什么是备兑看涨期权及其运作方式？
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre tracks options trading activity around Apple (AAPL) shares, specifically explaining how a covered call works. Apple will be reporting its fiscal third quarter earnings results after the closing bell on Thursday, July 30.
summary_zh: 雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 追踪苹果 (AAPL) 股票的期权交易活动，特别解释了备兑看涨期权的运作方式。苹果将​​于 7 月 30 日星期四收盘后公布第三财季盈利结果。

title: Rivian R2 production ramp, profit path key for investors: Q2 preview
title_zh: Rivian R2 产量增加，投资者的利润路径关键：第二季度预览
summary: Rivian is set to report second quarter results on Thursday, with investors focused on the ramp of its new R2 SUV and the electric vehicle maker's path toward narrowing losses.
summary_zh: Rivian 将于周四公布第二季度业绩，投资者关注其新款 R2 SUV 的销量增长以及这家电动汽车制造商缩小亏损的道路。
